description:
Quiet a Racing Mind | Slow Dilruba | Indian Classical

The day is over, but your mind didn't get the message.

The thoughts keep looping — replaying conversations, rehearsing tomorrow, circling back on the same worry you already set down an hour ago. You're tired, but your head won't slow to match. This isn't about forcing sleep. It's about giving a racing mind somewhere softer to land.

This is 90 minutes of slow Dilruba in Raga Kafi — a bowed Indian string instrument that sounds almost like a human voice, warm and a little melancholic. Kafi is a tender late-evening raga; its gentle, soft notes don't demand anything from you. The Dilruba's long, vocal phrases move slowly enough that the looping thoughts gradually lose their grip. No percussion, no rhythm to chase — just the bow drawing one unhurried line after another.

Leave it playing while you sit, read, journal, or simply let the evening close. Let the mind slow down to the pace of the music instead of the other way around.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Dilruba — bowed Indian string instrument, warm and vocal, like a voice gently sighing
- Raga Kafi — soft, tender late-evening raga with soothing minor-leaning notes
- Long, slow sustained phrases with gentle slides between them
- No tabla, no percussion — spacious and unhurried
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz with subtle Theta-wave tones underneath

⏱ Chapters
0:00    Settling the noise
20:00   The mind begins to slow
45:00   Letting the loops fade
70:00   Quiet and still
85:00   Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play and stop trying to direct your thoughts. Let the Dilruba's slow phrases set the pace. Each time the mind speeds back up, return your attention to the bow. There's nothing to do but let it slow you down.

⏱ Best for:
• An evening mind that won't switch off
• Thoughts that keep looping at night
• Winding down after a long or busy day
• Quiet reading, journaling, or sitting before bed
• Slowing a restless head without forcing sleep

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Kafi — soft, tender late-evening raga. Sa Re Ga(komal) Ma Pa Dha Ni(komal) Sa. The komal Ga (flat 3rd) and komal Ni (flat 7th) give Kafi its gentle, slightly minor, soothing romance/tenderness — well suited to a mind winding down without pushing toward sleep. NO tabla and NO other percussion — Dilruba is bowed, keep it spacious so the vocal sustained tone and slow meend carry the silence. Tanpura drone only. Theta 5Hz binaural (carrier ~200Hz) — deep mental quieting for a looping mind, deeper than Alpha but not the Delta of a pure sleep ship. LUFS -14 (evening, viewer awake and present, not drifting off). First clip must establish the warm vocal bowed tone and slow portamento before extending. EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1: 'like the looping thoughts finally losing their grip' · clip 2: 'the mind slowing down to the pace of the bow' · clip 3: 'a tired head finally allowed to go quiet'. 90min = 3-4 Suno clips + loop extension. First Kafi on Dilruba — confirm the raga reads as Kafi (komal Ga + komal Ni) in the first clip before committing.
